Comets LANding is our community Gaming & Esports Center located in the heart of campus; across from the Founders Building and adjacent to our Student Union. Comets LANding is open to all members of the UT Dallas community. With two floors encompassing 16,000 square feet, numerous PCs and popular console areas, there are opportunities for gamers of all skill levels.
